fallbacks.title: Platform defaults for uncovered controls
fallbacks.statement: If the system defines no control for a need, use the platform's native element with the wink field styling (radius 8, warm ink text); keep native semantics.
constraints: mark the improvisation and report a gap if the need recurs

fallbacks.title: Light surfaces only
fallbacks.statement: No dark-mode canon exists; if a dark surface is unavoidable, keep ink/yellow roles and mark the improvisation.
